name: Starlog Enterprises Limited
about: Starlog Enterprises Limited operates port and infrastructure facilities in India. The company also engages in the charter hire and operation of heavy-duty cranes; and engineering and erection activities. In addition, it provides heavy lift, plant erection, and maintenance services; and crane hire and mobilisation services. The company was formerly known as ABG Infralogistics Limited and changed its name to Starlog Enterprises Limited in October 2015. Starlog Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
